description: ERC-20 token metadata for one contract on Base mainnet: name, symbol, decimals, and total supply (human-readable and raw), with a flag for whether it behaves like an ERC-20 at all and whether it is native USDC. Handles older tokens that return bytes32 names. Useful for formatting token amounts correctly and spotting look-alike tokens. Read-only. Not charged for an invalid address or an address with no contract. Paid via x402; see list_prices.
name: chain_token
title: ERC-20 token info on Base: name, symbol, decimals, total supply
